description: BatchNorm forward inference (spatial mode, estimated mean and inverse variance as inputs) in the HIP_MLOPS_ENGINE region: rank 4 or 5, NCHW/NCDHW or NHWC/NDHWC strides, float/half/bfloat16 x with float scale, bias, mean and inv-variance, y in x's dtype or widened to float (the 'upcast' sweep cases; the inference kernel takes its output type separately, BatchNormFwdInferSpatial.cpp:8, and the reference signature keys register y in {x dtype, float} only, GpuBatchnormFwdInfSignatureKey.hpp:113-147), hw and c swept around the vector-width cut points (inCstride % 4, c % 4, % 2 in computeVectorSize, PlanUtils.hpp:69-84) and powers of two +-1. N*H*W may be 1: inference uses stored statistics (BatchnormInferenceNode.hpp:119). Template: quick BatchnormInference/Default (the only inference topology; BatchnormInferenceVarianceExt is a separate op). The quick sweep sets no metadata.inputs, so the harness op defaults (mean -0.1..0.1, inv_variance 0.5..1.5, FillInputs.cpp:94-95) apply to the other inputs. The last axis, domain (default/narrow/wide/positive/constant), renders the fill of x (uid 1); default is the harness default -1..1.

derive.d: ds if ndim == 5 and (hw // h) % ds == 0 else 1
derive.dims_x: [n, c, h, w] if ndim == 4 else [n, c, d, h, w]
derive.xs_h: w if layout == 'nchw' else w * c
derive.xs_d: h * w if layout == 'nchw' else h * w * c
derive.xs_c: d * h * w if layout == 'nchw' else 1
derive.stride_x: [xs_n, xs_c, xs_h, xs_w] if ndim == 4 else [xs_n, xs_c, xs_d, xs_h, xs_w]
derive.dom_lo: -0.01 if domain == 'narrow' else -8.0 if domain == 'wide' else 0.25 if domain == 'positive' else 0.5 if domain == 'constant' else -1.0
derive.dom_hi: 0.01 if domain == 'narrow' else 8.0 if domain == 'wide' else 4.0 if domain == 'positive' else 0.5 if domain == 'constant' else 1.0

constraints.reason: GPU reference cost ceiling for normalization ops (RFC 0023 section 14); also keeps every extent inside the checkedNarrowToInt int range the inference plan requires (BatchnormFwdInferencePlan.cpp:137-158, PlanUtils.hpp:19)
